title: Hybrid IDS
shortDescription: Hybrid Intrusion Detection System monitoring real-time web traffic and detecting malicious attacks using combined rule-based filtering and AI classification.
description: Hybrid IDS is a full-stack cybersecurity application designed to monitor live web traffic, detect incoming attack vectors, and broadcast instant security alerts. The system combines deterministic rule-based signature matching with machine learning anomaly detection to stop exploits with low false-positive rates.
role: Full-Stack & Security Engineer (Traffic Interception, Detection Engine, Real-Time Dashboard & Stripe Billing)
architecture: Client Request → mitmproxy Interception → Flask Proxy Engine → Rule-Based Detection & ML Classification → Socket.IO Real-Time Alert Engine → Next.js Dashboard

screenshots.title: Hybrid IDS Real-Time Traffic & Alert Dashboard

overview.purpose: Provide network administrators and web hosts with real-time visibility into malicious HTTP/S traffic through dual-layer attack detection.
overview.targetAudience: Security analysts, system administrators, and organizations seeking proactive web application defense.
overview.problemSolved: Bridges the gap between rigid signature-only detection (which misses novel zero-day attacks) and sluggish pure-ML models (which overload servers).

requirements: Low-latency traffic interception capable of reading HTTP request headers and payloads
Immediate detection of standard attack signatures (SQLi, XSS, Path Traversal)
Machine learning classification model for spotting anomalous, non-standard attack vectors
Real-time alert broadcasting to connected dashboards without manual browser refreshes
Tiered subscription access model integrated with Stripe payment processing
solution: Built a multi-stage inspection pipeline: live network requests flow through mitmproxy into a Flask proxy engine. Known threat patterns are filtered instantaneously by rule-based signatures, while suspicious payloads are evaluated by an AI model. Critical incidents trigger instant WebSockets alerts via Socket.IO directly to an interactive Next.js telemetry dashboard.
features: Real-time network traffic interception and payload extraction using mitmproxy
Dual-layer detection: high-speed deterministic rule matching followed by ML anomaly detection
Instant low-latency security alerts broadcast to the web dashboard via Socket.IO WebSockets
Interactive incident analytics displaying attack origin, severity ranking, and payload logs
Stripe payment gateway integration for commercial subscription tiers
Administrative dashboard for security policy adjustments and incident mitigation
technicalChallenges: Minimizing processing latency introduced by proxy interception on high-throughput HTTP traffic
Balancing AI classification sensitivity to prevent benign user requests from being flagged as malicious
Maintaining persistent, reliable WebSocket connections between Flask and the Next.js telemetry client
implementationDetails: Implemented a custom mitmproxy inline script to forward intercepted request payloads to Flask via fast local sockets
Built a hybrid evaluation worker separating fast regex-based signature scans from asynchronous ML model inference
Constructed a reactive Socket.IO event emitter channel pushing structured incident telemetry to frontend listeners
Integrated Stripe webhook handlers verifying subscription state transitions before granting premium alert feeds
testingQuality: Security simulation testing using simulated attack payloads (SQL injection, XSS vectors, parameter fuzzing)
WebSocket connection resilience testing under simulated network drops and reconnections
End-to-end payment testing using Stripe test clocks and mock card transactions
Responsive UI validation of log inspection tables across tablet and mobile viewports

Semantic documentation formatting allowing generative AI engines (GEO) to accurately parse the system architecture
Clear question-and-answer technical sections for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
Accurate Open Graph cards and canonical indexing configuration
performance: Sequential multi-tier filtering ensuring lightweight rules run first, skipping heavy ML processing for obviously benign traffic
Asynchronous log batching preventing disk I/O bottlenecks during traffic bursts

security: Complete threat detection pipeline covering OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities

faq.question: How does Nexa Event prevent duplicate seat purchases during flash sales?
faq.answer: Selected seats are placed under distributed Redis locks with a 10-minute TTL hold. The purchase transaction confirms availability atomically before debiting payment.

title: E-Commerce Platform
shortDescription: Modern online store application built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS featuring product catalogs and cart workflows.
description: An interactive e-commerce web application featuring real-time product browsing, interactive cart additions, and responsive checkout views.

overview.purpose: Provide shoppers with a fast, lightweight online catalog for product discovery and cart management.
overview.problemSolved: Delivers an instant-loading, snappy single-page shopping experience.

requirements: Instant product filtering by category and price
Dynamic cart badge and persistent checkout items
Responsive mobile-friendly product grid
solution: Built a lightweight React SPA with atomic components and Tailwind utility classes for high-speed browsing.
features: Fast client-side routing and instant filtering
Interactive cart with dynamic quantity adjustments
Responsive product grids with image previews
technicalChallenges: Optimizing client-side product search across extensive item lists
implementationDetails: Built atomic product card components with memoized state handlers
testingQuality: Cart state testing confirming item additions, quantity changes, and removals
seoGeoAeo: Semantic HTML product markup and clear image alt tags
performance: Vite fast bundle compilation and optimized assets
security: Sanitized client-side form inputs
